tasks.title: Motor noise frequency
tasks.statement: A **{kv} KV** motor, **{u} V** under load, and the RPM with the prop is **{k} %** below no-load. Find the frequency of the fundamental (Hz) — the center for the RPM filter.
tasks.solution: n = KV·U·(1 − k/100) RPM, f = n/60. This is the fundamental; the RPM filter places notches on harmonics 1, 2 and 3.
